page_title: MCI 3-1 WHU | Manchester City v West Ham 19/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
90+1' The referee signals a substitution. Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) is brought on as a substitute for Phil Foden.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' Celebrations are cut short for West Ham as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was handball!
89' The West Ham players halt their celebrations as referee John Brooks makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a handball in the build-up play.
88' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) latches onto a brilliant cross and produces a perfect header that goes inside the left post to give the goalkeeper no chance!
87' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. West Ham will take a corner kick.
86' Lucas Paqueta comes off the pitch to be replaced by Danny Ings (West Ham).
86' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
85' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) beats his marker in the air and aims a header at goal from the free kick, but the close-range effort flashes just past the right post.
84' John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul after Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) hacks down one of his opponents.
83' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) takes the corner kick, but Alphonse Areola reads it well and stops the effort.
81' Substitution. Michail Antonio makes his way off the pitch and George Earthy (West Ham) comes on as his replacement.
81' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
79' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
75' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Edson Alvarez (West Ham).
74' Phil Foden (Manchester City) sends the resulting free kick a whisker wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
71' David Moyes has decided to substitute Emerson and he is replaced by Edson Alvarez (West Ham).
71' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nathan Ake (Manchester City) will replace Manuel Akanji.
70' Phil Foden (Manchester City) swings in a cross from the corner, but Alphonse Areola reads it well and gathers the ball.
69' Phil Foden (Manchester City) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

68' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out. The referee points to the corner flag and Manchester City will take a corner.
68' Alphonse Areola comes off his line to intercept the corner from Phil Foden (Manchester City).
67' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

66' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
63' Phil Foden (Manchester City) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
59' 3 - 1 Goal! Rodri (Manchester City) shows perfect technique and produces a first-time effort from just outside the box that goes into the bottom right corner. It's 3:1.
57' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
54' The free kick is delivered by Phil Foden (Manchester City) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
54' Phil Foden (Manchester City) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
52' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Erling Haaland.

51' What an opportunity! Phil Foden (Manchester City) picked the ball up and fired a projectile of a shot from long range which threatened the goalkeeper. The shot went painfully close to the left post!
50' That was close by Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post.
48' Manchester City control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
47' It looks like Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) saw red with that tackle. John Brooks won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' John Brooks blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Stefan Ortega intercepts the ball.
45+1' CHANCE! Erling Haaland (Manchester City) picks up a perfect pass inside the box, makes himself some space for a shot, but his effort goes just over the crossbar.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
42' 2 - 1 GOAL! Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) gets on the scoresheet after finding some space in the box to acrobatically score from the corner kick. 2:1.
42' The ball is out of play. West Ham will have a chance to score from a corner.
42' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play. West Ham are awarded a corner kick.
41' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Phil Foden.
41' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.

38' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the left post. Stefan Ortega pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.

37' A big opportunity is wasted by Rodri (Manchester City), who makes a yard for himself and produces a mid-range rocket of a shot towards the left side of the goal. Unfortunately for him, Alphonse Areola pulls off a fantastic save to stop the effort.
32' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
30' Jeremy Doku loses the ball after receiving a sweet pass from Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City).
28' The corner is flicked onto Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City), but his close-range header flies a whisker wide of the right post.
28' There's an opportunity for Phil Foden (Manchester City) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

27' Nice move, nice attempt! Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) is teed up with a simple pass after a nice flowing move. His first time shot from mid-range looks like it's going in but curls just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.

27' Manuel Akanji (Manchester City) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Alphonse Areola makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the right side of the goal.
25' Phil Foden (Manchester City) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.

25' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. John Brooks blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Manchester City win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
24' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) connects with a precise cross inside the goalmouth and shoots. One of the defending players reacts in time and clears the ball to safety.
23' Phil Foden (Manchester City) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
23' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. Manchester City get a corner.
22' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) attempts to find his teammate with a short pass into the box. Erling Haaland collects the ball, but his attack is thwarted by the defence.
18' 2 - 0 Goal - 2:0! Jeremy Doku tees up Phil Foden (Manchester City) inside the box and he curls the ball into the right side of the net and past Alphonse Areola.

17' Good chance! Rodri (Manchester City) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
16' The resulting corner from Phil Foden (Manchester City) comes to nothing.

16' Alphonse Areola was forced into action to thwart Jeremy Doku (Manchester City). He found himself some space after picking up a pass and unleashed a shot to the top right corner but couldn't beat the keeper. The ball goes out of play. Manchester City are awarded a corner kick.
14' Kurt Zouma (West Ham) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
14' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.

11' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) has the opportunity to threaten the opponent's goal via a free kick on the edge of the box. He hits a fine strike towards the left side of the goal, but Alphonse Areola denies him with a great save.
10' John Brooks blows his whistle after Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
9' Great teamplay by Manchester City as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
6' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
5' Rodri (Manchester City) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Erling Haaland.
2' 1 - 0 Phil Foden (Manchester City) controls the ball with an excellent first touch on the edge of the penalty box after receiving a splendid pass and smashes the ball into the top right corner!
1' The match has just started.
Manchester City will kick-off.
John Brooks is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
